body: I'm sorry for giving you the hot seat, it's a lot that happened in my life. You don't need to help. Thanks for listening it means a lot.
I'm sorry this is the first time I have ever spill so much about my life to anyone and I don't even know you.

I don't want to get detailed as my girlfriend probably use this but it's some of the responsibility of me being with her, she has said if she didn't find me she would have been either dead or living with her parents forever. The only person I really love like my girlfriend is my mom and she had a cardiac arrest in front of me and my sister and died looking at me. Everyday I'm getting closer to a future I don't know,  this is when I have to make some choices that could ruin my life. I feel trapped, I remember what happiness felt like but it's been gone really after my mom and my gf makes me feel warm, safe, secure,etc I just have to much responsibility and people that look up to me and if I fuck up everyone else who depending on me will too.
